what_was_found: No paper reports CLDN4 protein going to lysosomes or being rescued by lysosome inhibitors after any ADC.
what_was_not_found: A treatment experiment: ADC on, CLDN4 protein down, lysosome-dependent (chloroquine/bafilomycin/LAMP1).

what_was_found: SG/Dato/SKB264 papers show TROP2/ADC internalization and payload release. None measure CLDN4 protein fate or lysosomal CLDN4.
what_was_not_found: CLDN4 WB/IF after SG, Dato-DXd, or SKB264 with a lysosome-rescue or LAMP1-coloc readout.

query: CLDN4-targeted ADC reports CLDN4 lysosomal degradation
what_was_found: No peer-reviewed CLDN4-ADC with CLDN4 protein-fate data. CLDN6/CLDN18.2 ADCs exist; CLDN4 clinical ADCs do not. Patent WO2016175551 is a dendron-doxorubicin conjugate, not a paper.
what_was_not_found: A published anti-CLDN4 ADC figure showing CLDN4 in LAMP1+ lysosomes or chloroquine rescue of CLDN4.
